representativeTask.title: AnythingLLM RAG: embed a knowledge file and answer a grounded question through every delegated surface
representativeTask.description: The pinned AnythingLLM runtime (Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm, revision fa7ec877f005a21ede94888b3b8618b700343857, v1.17.0, standard distribution profile) runs as its own real OS processes over the exact checkout — the collector and the server booted exactly the way the app's own docker-entrypoint boots them (prisma migrate deploy → node collector/index.js + node server/index.js) — configured entirely through its own documented environment surface: the generic-openai LLM provider connector and the generic-openai embedding engine, STT and TTS connectors at the local Zeck adapter's OpenAI-shaped surface, and the Ollama local-inference rail at the adapter's Ollama-native surface (selected per-workspace through the app's own chatProvider/chatModel override). The representative task uploads the Lighthouse Operations Manual through the app's developer document API (the app's collector extracts the text, the server embeds every chunk through the delegated embeddings edge — executed by the Zeck-side deterministic strategy over the recorded supply boundary), embeds it into the workspace, then asks a grounded question through the workspace chat API (the app embeds the query through the same delegated edge, retrieves through its own LanceDB vector pipeline, answers grounded through the delegated chat edge), and the mechanical check verifies the answer quotes the document's distinctive gate code — with Zeck as the sole AI execution authority on every surface: chat/generation on both the remote and local rails, RAG embeddings, retrieval-augmented answering, speech recognition and speech generation.

reproducibility.instructions: Prepare the pinned checkout: git clone https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm.git /home/z/anythingllm-upstream && git -C /home/z/anythingllm-upstream checkout fa7ec877f005a21ede94888b3b8618b700343857 (release tag v1.17.0). Install the app's own dependencies exactly as its Dockerfile does: cd /home/z/anythingllm-upstream/server && yarn install --frozen-lockfile and cd /home/z/anythingllm-upstream/collector && PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true yarn install --frozen-lockfile (the collector's puppeteer Chromium download is skipped — the web-scrape ingest surface is an egress-denied dormant seam, never exercised). Node >= 18.12.1 (the proof ran Node 24, whose NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY the certified egress control uses). Then run the battery: bun run compat/anythingllm/harness/run-battery.ts from the Zeck checkout (resumable; every step checkpoints to /tmp/ppr-026-battery/battery-state.json; a completed run terminates cleanly). The battery requires the sandbox's authorized GLM supply config (/etc/.z-ai-config) — platform-side BYOK material, read at composition time, never present in the AnythingLLM runtime, the adapter process env, the repository or any evidence artifact — and composes the full certified plane in-process: the Zeck world + executions authority, the multi-surface GLM supply rail (chat text/vision + asr + tts; NO embeddings — probed 404, the Zeck-side deterministic embeddings executor covers the edge), the multi-protocol adapter (OpenAI-shaped /v1 + the Ollama-native local rail), and the scrubbed egress-deny environment (the positive control: direct provider egress must be BLOCKED).
